arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
DB="$BASE/openwebui-data/webui.db"
WARM="$BASE/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh"
echo -n "WARM_MODE="; stat -c '%a' "$WARM"
echo -n "WARM_SHA256="; sha256sum "$WARM" | awk '{print $1}'
echo -n "WARM_CRON_COUNT="; (crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -F -c "$WARM" || true
"$BASE/envs/openwebui/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,json,subprocess,urllib.request
db="/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/openwebui-data/webui.db"
ids=["ahsoka-tano","deepseek-r1:1.5b","gemma3:270m","granite4.2:3b","lfm2.5:8b-a1b-q4_K_M","local-agent-mini-c-agent","ornith:latest","qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-instruct-q4_K_M","qwen3:4b-instruct"]
c=sqlite3.connect("file:"+db+"?mode=ro",uri=True); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; c.execute("pragma query_only=on")
for k in ("task.model.default","task.model.external","task.model.params"):
 r=c.execute('select value,updated_at from config where "key"=?',(k,)).fetchone()
 print("CFG",k,json.dumps(dict(r) if r else None,separators=(",",":")))
for mid in ids:
 r=c.execute("select id,params,updated_at,is_active from model where id=?",(mid,)).fetchone()
 if not r:
  print("ROW",mid,"MISSING"); continue
 p=json.loads(r["params"] or "{}")
 print("ROW",mid,json.dumps({"updated_at":r["updated_at"],"is_active":r["is_active"],"keep_alive":p.get("keep_alive"),"num_ctx":p.get("num_ctx"),"num_thread":p.get("num_thread")},separators=(",",":")))
print("DB_INTEGRITY",c.execute("pragma integrity_check").fetchone()[0]); c.close()
pid=subprocess.check_output(["pgrep","-f","^/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/miniconda/bin/ollama serve$"],text=True).splitlines()[0]
env=open("/proc/"+pid+"/environ","rb").read().split(b"\0")
keys=(b"OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=",b"OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=",b"OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=",b"OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=",b"OLLAMA_NUM_THREAD=",b"OLLAMA_MAX_QUEUE=")
print("OLLAMA_ENV",json.dumps(sorted(x.decode() for x in env if x.startswith(keys)),separators=(",",":")))
with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps",timeout=5) as r:
 print("OLLAMA_PS",json.dumps(json.load(r),separators=(",",":")))
PY
